User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the Mindwell application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, from Firebase Auth.

profilePicture.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

sentimentAnalysisEnabled.description: Flag indicating whether sentiment analysis is enabled for the user.

dataRetentionPeriod.description: Data retention period in days for the user's data.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Represents a chat session between a user and the AI assistant.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatSession entity.

startTime.description: Timestamp indicating the start time of the chat session.

endTime.description: Timestamp indicating the end time of the chat session.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single message within a chat session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatMessage entity.

userId.description: The UID of the user who sent the message.

sender.description: Indicates who sent the message ('user' or 'assistant').

content.description: The text content of the message.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

SentimentAnalysis.title: SentimentAnalysis
SentimentAnalysis.description: Represents the sentiment analysis results for a specific chat message.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SentimentAnalysis entity.

sentimentScore.description: A numerical score representing the sentiment of the message (e.g., -1 to 1).

emotion.description: The identified emotion in the message (e.g., 'joy', 'sadness', 'anger').

VoiceBlob.title: VoiceBlob
VoiceBlob.description: Represents a voice recording uploaded by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VoiceBlob entity.

audioDataUri.description: Base64 data URI representing the audio recording.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the voice recording was created.

Recommendation.title: Recommendation
Recommendation.description: Represents a personalized recommendation provided to the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Recommendation entity.

chatMessageId.description: Reference to ChatMessage that triggered the recommendation. (Relationship: ChatMessage 1:N Recommendation)

recommendationText.description: The text content of the recommendation.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the recommendation was generated.

Badge.title: Badge
Badge.description: Represents a badge awarded to a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Badge entity (e.g., 'first-chat').

achievedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the badge was achieved.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure authorization independence, clarity, and scalability, adhering to the principles of DBAC (Database-Based Access Control) and QAPs (Rules are not Filters). The structure prioritizes path-based ownership and membership maps for collaborative data access, eliminating the need for `get()` calls in security rules and enabling atomic operations.

*   **Authorization Independence:** Achieved through denormalization. Specifically, any data requiring access control based on parent attributes (e.g., collaborative chat sessions) will have relevant user roles/permissions denormalized into the child documents (not applicable here, as user-owned data is used.)
*   **QAPs Support:** The structure uses structural segregation to guarantee that all documents within a collection share identical security requirements, which facilitates secure list operations.

Here's how each collection contributes to these goals:

*   `/users/{userId}`: Stores user profiles, using path-based ownership for private user data. This ensures only the authenticated user can access their profile. User ID from `request.auth.uid` is explicitly included as a field in the document, improving readability and debuggability.
*   `/users/{userId}/chatSessions/{chatSessionId}`: Stores chat sessions owned by a specific user.  This structure enforces a clear ownership model, making security rules straightforward.
*   `/users/{userId}/chatSessions/{chatSessionId}/chatMessages/{chatMessageId}`: Stores individual chat messages within a chat session, maintaining the path-based ownership for data security.
*   `/users/{userId}/chatSessions/{chatSessionId}/chatMessages/{chatMessageId}/sentimentAnalysis/{sentimentAnalysisId}`: Stores sentiment analysis results for specific messages. The path reflects that sentiment analysis is only accessible in context of a message. Sentiment analysis data is not meant to be accessed independent of a chat message.
*   `/users/{userId}/voiceBlobs/{voiceBlobId}`: Stores voice recordings uploaded by users, maintaining the path-based ownership for user privacy.
*   `/users/{userId}/recommendations/{recommendationId}`: Stores personalized recommendations for each user, derived from sentiment analysis and chat context. These are owned by the user and accessible via path based rules.
*   `/users/{userId}/badges/{badgeId}`: Stores the badges a user has earned. The path-based ownership model ensures that users can only view and manage their own badges.
